Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Me-Gami
rows.Origin:
Bred by Seizo Suzuki (Japan, before 1970).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 1970 as 'Me-Gami'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Mild fragrance. 33 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage:

Fragrant Cloud (hybrid tea, Tantau 1963)
